name: GalaxyCon Des Moines
blurb: A three-day Des Moines festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, with celebrities, voice actors, comic creators, wrestlers and fan groups at the Iowa Events Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON DES MOINES ... SEPTEMBER 10-12, 2027 ... We look forward to seeing you September 10-12, 2027 at the Iowa Events Center'

notes: Two cards (#0 'Celebrities Travis Willingham' and #1 'Voice Actors Travis Willingham', one per section he's cross-listed under) both point to the same image file, 2027-GC-NolanNorth-...jpg — a genuine photo mix-up on GalaxyCon's own page (confirmed from the raw img URL, not a truncated-alt false alarm), so rather than show Nolan North's photo under Travis Willingham's name he's filed as a textOnlyGuest. #6 'Literary & Industry Coming Soon' and #23 'Tattoo Artists Coming Soon' are category placeholders, and #24-25 (JSA, Agents of Slabs) are Authentication vendor services, not individual guests — all excluded. Known for is left blank throughout (cards show only name + attendance days). Cover uses the Des Moines wordmark logo; the homepage's other images are the shared 11-city promo, a generic galaxy background, decorative props, fan/after-dark stock photos, and a ticket-sale banner.
